comment: ColabFold's Pallas kernels, measured on the same card this project is developed on:
an NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell. Reproduce with the recipe in docs, or read the
sources listed on each row. Add a row when a new Pallas kernel is measured; the
tool matches a row to our kernels by the labels it names and says nothing where
no row matches, rather than inventing a comparison.
Two kinds of figure appear. tflops is a rate measured on one kernel at one shape
and is the honest thing to compare, because it survives a change of length.
millisecondsPerBlock is what a profile of a whole Evoformer block reported and
only compares at the length it was taken at, which every row carries.

baselines.name: tri_flash, attention
baselines.source: rate on batch 64, 825 queries, 8 heads, head 32, against our 87.4 on the same shape; block total from a traced steady-state recycle, 2026-09-08. Head 32 only: the extra stack attends over 8 and pads it to the matrix unit's 16, so it does twice the counted work and this rate is not its rate

baselines.source: bandwidth bound at 1.37 TB/s, about 75% of this card's peak; a FLOP rate says nothing here, 2026-09-08
